_comment: P2-063 (effects-claude, 2026-10-12). Presentation only, shipping OFF until a code-blind PASS: scripts/vfx/tell_timing_cue.gd draws (a) a 'landing now' front that runs from the attacker to the edge of its target's footprint during the wind-up and arrives on the strike, and (b) an 'opening' rim pulse around the whole foe while it is staggered or recovering after its swing. Reads combat state only; no timing, AI, damage or transaction is changed.
